Name: Miniature Villagers
Author: ch0opera
Description:
[center][font=Arial]
[b]
[color=#d0e0e3]Here are some cute mini versions of the non-marriageable NPCs to display as decorative toy figurines. [/color][/b]
[color=#a2c4c9][size=3]They may or may not be soft and squishy.
You will have to be the judge of that. [/size][/color]
[size=3]
[color=#d0e0e3]This mod was inspired by existing plushy mods, notably [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16716?tab=description]LennonsLemons[/url]﻿﻿﻿' (AT) plushies for bachelors & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11753?tab=posts]Elfenlibelle[/url]﻿'s Wooly Plushies for AT. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#a4c2f4][b] NPCs eligible to become mini villagers:[/b][/color]

[color=#a2c4c9][size=3]The miniature villagers are 16×16 each (very smol)
Made for[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ (AT)[/size][/color]
[size=5]🎨

[/size][size=3][b][color=#76a5af]How to:[/color][/b] [/size][color=#d0e0e3][size=3]Use the AT Paint Bucket tool on any 16×16 furniture item to retexture it into the Mini Villager of your choice![/size]
[/color]
